sentences.text: The Petitioners claim to be owners of Ac. 1.00 cents situated in common Sy.No.465/3 at Pedapalakaluru Village, Guntur District.

A Notice dated 10.12.2018 was issued by the Respondent No.2 calling upon, the Petitioners to handover the possession to an extent of 270 sq. yards ( 90 sq.yards from the property of the Petitioner No.1 and 180 sq. yards from the property of the Petitioner No.2) for the purpose of laying the Mahatma Gandhi Inner Ring Road, Phase-lll.
3.
Learned Counsel for the Petitioners s'ubmits that though the Petitioners did not give consent, the Respondent Authorities are trying to lay a road.

He further submits that the Respondent Authorities vide endorsement dated 12.01.2023 and 18.01.2023 informed to the Petitioners that an extent of Ac.0-21/2 cents and Ac.0.05 cents are required from the Petitioners for the said purpose and to that effect a notice under Section 146 of the Andhra Pradesh Municipal Corporation Act was issued.
jT 4. Learned Standing Counsel on instructions submits that the Petitioners themselves have agreed for the TDK Bonds vide Letter dated 14.06.2023 and the same proves the consent of the Petitioners.

He further submits that the Respondent Authorities would be issuing TDRs to the Petitioners for the land acquired from their possession within a period of eight weeks from the date of execution of gift deed by the Petitioners.

5. Taking note of the submissions of the learned Standing Counsel, the Writ Petition can be disposed of with the following directions;
i) The Petitioners shall execute Gift Deeds for the extent of land acquired from their possession within a period of four weeks ii) The Respondent Authorities shall issue TDRs to the Petitioners for the land acquired from the possession of the Petitioners within a further period of 12 weeks from the date of execution of Gift Deeds.
iii) No order as to costs.
6. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
